review_fixes.result: Remove every event-record wall bypass, scope, mint/verify path and service elevation exception. All ten record kinds enforce service walls, delegated viewers, list omission and next-read wall removal. The obsolete runtime capability flag is also removed and asserted unsupported.
Delete response buffering and wall-membership metadata. Directory checks caller access before candidate filtering.
Preserve batch 1 sha256=<hex> raw-body HMAC plus separate Unix timestamp; require both headers, nonempty secret, constant-time comparison and the fixed five-minute window.

Keep delegated actor_id as the user; expand-only migration 1550 adds events.module_id. Practice, billing, files, calendar, module mail and appended events retain who/via attribution; person filter/counts and timeline cover it.
Contract settings require the bearer settings:read scope as well as install approval. Every module call remains audited under its module id, delegated or background.
Replace stale evidence; target batch2 and bind tests to the final implementation revision. CU2-07 is run with unchanged dependency packages.
Remove event-record read grants entirely. A module-appended event naming a walled contact creates no credential and cannot authorize a read.
Service read audit rows identify the exact operation and requested record path. Tests assert an exact additional row, including token/module provenance, per affected record get and new read.

Delete obsolete event-token tests with the removed mechanism; replace them with no-grant delivery, forged/legacy-header and appended-event wall regressions. No expiry check can mask a module/signature check because no grant path survives.
ProviderCRC returns Zoom hex HMAC for encryptedToken. ProviderCRCBase64 names the separate sha256=<base64> convention.
Event post, contract calls and routed mail refuse empty webhook secrets before outbound delivery.
Phone action frames carry phone_id and contact_id only; the module reads the number through the API.
Align conventions, module kit, API/MCP docs, contributor gaps, generated OpenAPI, simulator and inventory with the single retained webhook format.
events_api omits actor_name rather than returning a raw id; the timeline resolves user display names.
Use plain decimal and zero literals. Source checking recognizes the core protocol functions and still rejects tunables in other functions.
